user.title: Set up OSDP controller
user.description: Select the RS-485 adapter the OSDP readers are wired to. Paths under /dev/serial/by-id stay the same across reboots and are preferred. {hint}

data_description.port: Pick a detected adapter or type a device path.
data_description.baudrate: Must match the speed configured on the readers (commonly 9600 or 115200).

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure OSDP controller
reconfigure.description: Change the serial port or baud rate of this bus.

error.cannot_connect: The serial port could not be opened. Check the path and that no other program is using it.

abort.already_configured: This serial port is already configured.

add_reader.title: Add a reader
add_reader.description: Each reader on the bus has a unique OSDP address (0–126).

data_description.scbk: Optional 16-byte key as 32 hex characters. When set, the connection is encrypted and the reader is only used once the secure channel is up. Leave empty for an unencrypted connection.
32 hex characters. Clear the field to disable the secure channel.

data_description.run_as_user: Optional. Card scans and key presses are recorded as done by this user, e.g. in the logbook.

error.duplicate: A reader with this address already exists.
error.invalid_scbk: The key must be exactly 32 hexadecimal characters.

not_a_reader.message: Device {device_id} is not an OSDP reader.

not_loaded.message: The OSDP controller for this reader is not loaded.

command_failed.message: The command could not be queued for reader {address}.

set_led.name: Set LED
set_led.description: Sets the LED of a reader, permanently or temporarily.

color.name: Color
color.description: Color while the LED is on.

off_color.name: Off color
off_color.description: Color during the off phase when blinking.

on_time.name: On time
on_time.description: Blink on time. Leave both on and off time at 0 for a steady color.

duration.name: Duration
duration.description: If set, the LED returns to its previous state after this time (e.g. green for 3 s on access granted).

led_number.name: LED number
led_number.description: LED index on readers with several LEDs.

beep.name: Beep
beep.description: Sounds the buzzer of a reader.

set_output.name: Set output
set_output.description: Switches an output (e.g. a door strike relay) on a reader.

state.name: State
state.description: Turn the output on or off.

duration.name: Duration
duration.description: If set, the output reverts after this time (e.g. unlock for 5 s).
